summary: Build vendor scorecards, governance controls, and implementation oversight skills in 5 days. Train with practical templates and exercises.
lede: Technology vendor selection and implementation governance provides a structured way to identify, evaluate, contract with, onboard, and govern external technology providers. Defined requirements, evaluation scorecards, due diligence, service-level design, governance forums, and implementation controls help create clearer decisions and stronger supplier accountability. This course shows you how to build requirement matrices, compare vendors consistently, map implementation responsibilities, review SLA and KPI definitions, and prepare performance dashboards. You will also practice using control gates and AI-assisted proposal analysis to support executive review, implementation oversight, and practical governance without unnecessary bureaucracy.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who select technology vendors, govern implementation delivery, and manage third-party performance across IT and digital transformation work.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of procurement, IT project delivery, or vendor coordination processes. Prior experience with RFPs, SLAs, basic contract review, or service management is helpful, but no coding is required. Familiarity with spreadsheet-based scoring, stakeholder interviews, and implementation tracking will help you move faster during the exercises. The course is positioned at intermediate level and focuses on operational application, not advanced legal drafting or technical system integration.
